title: McDonald's ina mikahawa inayoendeshwa na kampuni na ya biashara ya franchise
label: Aina mbili za mikahawa

text.McDonald's in Japan actually has 2 kinds: Kwa kweli, McDonald's nchini Japani ina aina mbili za mikahawa.
text.\"Company-run stores\" run by the McDona: Baadhi ya mikahawa huendeshwa na kampuni yenyewe ya McDonald's, na mingine ya franchise huendeshwa na wamiliki.
text.There is no clear rule to tell them apar: Hakuna kanuni iliyo wazi ya kuitofautisha, lakini nina picha ya jumla.
text.Company-run stores are often inside city: Mikahawa ya kampuni mara nyingi huwa ndani ya majengo ya mjini au ndani ya stesheni.
text.I feel franchise stores are often in the: Ninahisi mikahawa ya franchise mara nyingi huwa nje kidogo ya jiji, katika jengo lake lenye McDonald's pekee.
text.The store I worked at was a company-run: Mgahawa nilikofanyia kazi uliendeshwa na kampuni yenyewe.
text.Looking back, my impression is that it w: Nikikumbuka, naona ulikuwa mkali katika mambo mengi.
text.Especially, the training on how to speak: Hasa, mafunzo ya jinsi ya kuzungumza yalichukuliwa kwa uzito.
text.It seems the area manager was strict too: Inaonekana meneja wa eneo pia alikuwa mkali, na meneja wa mgahawa pamoja na wasimamizi walifanya kazi kwa bidii kila wakati.
text.🚗 A standalone store in the suburbs: 🚗 Mgahawa wa pekee nje ya jiji
text.On the other hand, when I went to help a: Kwa upande mwingine, nilipoenda kusaidia kwenye mgahawa wa franchise, mazingira yalikuwa tofauti kabisa.
text.The way of speaking was not so strict, a: Hawakukaza sana kuhusu jinsi ya kuzungumza, na sheria za nywele na kucha zilikuwa huru zaidi.
text.Overall, it had a relaxed feeling that w: Kwa jumla, kulikuwa na hali ya utulivu tofauti na mgahawa wa kampuni.
text.If you want a relaxed part-time job, may: Ukitaka kazi ya muda isiyo na msongo, labda franchise inafurahisha zaidi 😅
text.But company-run stores have good points: Hata hivyo, mikahawa ya kampuni ina mambo mazuri pia.
text.They are strict about numbers and goals,: Walizingatia sana takwimu na malengo kama mauzo, kasi ya kutoa chakula, kuridhika kwenye tafiti na idadi ya malalamiko; kwa hiyo niliweza kufanya kazi kana kwamba ni mchezo.
text.When we reached a goal, the reward and s: Tulipofikia lengo, tulipata furaha na hisia kubwa ya mafanikio, na ilikuwa rahisi kuzama kabisa kwenye kazi.
text.🍔 MY McDONALD'S PART-TIME JOB: 🍔 Kazi yangu ya muda katika McDonald's
